book.name: GALESIA
book.title: GALESIA Galesia mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Sine siŋgine siŋgine tira tuku piti kugrakube
Tira kame, taŋgine taŋgo ande mbarmba ndekuwa ndeta tane afu Tukul Guwa tuku saŋgri ŋak minig ta tane ŋgan maŋaumbi nu te-tiwap. Tane kurau mayewap. Satan nu tane mata tagotiŋguwa le ndekubekaig.
Tane taŋgine taŋgine tira tuku piti kugrakap ta tane Kristus tuku tukul ŋakmba kumuwamŋgaig.
Taŋgo ima nu ye mayenu ŋga iduste ta nuŋe wamdusŋge nu yabrite. Nu ake taŋgo ndo.
Sine afu tuku mine kaŋgerka siŋgine mine pileŋga payam ndakube. Sine yimyam siŋgine miroŋ maŋau kaŋgerka pileniŋbe.
Sine ŋakmba ndui ndui siŋgine piti kugrakamŋgig.
Taŋgo ande nu Kuate tuku pasa mayenu kuklimba tane tumtiŋgit ta taŋgine agaŋ ndendembi nu turap.
Tane kuraukap. Tane Kuate tuku nzali pitaimba sine pa te nda ŋga idusap ta tane wamdus mbarbekaig. Taŋgo nu agaŋ tumunu ŋgukate ta nu alonu ndui ta ndo kilit.
Ne ŋgarosu tuku nzali dubiwa ta ne ŋgarosu tuku nzali alonu tumba ŋgisikamŋgat. Ne Tukul Guwa tuku wamdus dubiwa ta ne Tukul Guwa tuku alonu tumba Kuate ndoŋ abo ŋak minmba minamŋgat.
Sine wam magenu kam tuku kanyum ndasiŋguwa. Sine wamdus saŋgrinu pilmba wam magenu kumba minbe le ma ma ait kumuŋguwa le alonu kilamŋgig.
Afu mbolŋge wam magenu kam tuku ait prode ta sine kusre ndakube. Yesus tuku son ŋgade mbal siŋgine tira minig ta sine nane tur magekube.
Riroŋ pasa le nyaro pasa
Tane kaŋgerap. Ye yiŋe waimbi waŋe te mbolŋge kuyar sugokanu kuyaret.

Zu taŋgo afu saŋgri tiŋga tane ŋgaro pikam satiŋgig ta nane naŋgine mbal am mbolŋge nyu sugo tam tuku taŋade. Nane sine Kristus nu ail kazrai mbolŋge kumna wam ta ndo te-mayokbe ta siŋgine mbalŋge piti sersiŋbekaig ŋga nane kuru-kuruka ŋgaro pikam tuku wam turmba te-mayokde.
Ata. Ŋgaro pikig mbal ta nane tukul ŋakmba dubi ndakade. Tane ŋgaro pikam tuku satiŋgig ta tane ŋgarosu pikap le naŋgine ŋgaro payamkam tuku taŋade.

Ye wam ande tuku payam ndaket. Yesus Kristus nu ail kazrai mbolŋge kumna wam ta tuku ndo ye payamket. Taŋamba kilke te tuku wam kame ye am mbolŋge kumaknu taŋaŋ minig le ye idus ndaniŋget. Ye mata kilke te tuku maŋau dubide mbal am mbolŋge kumaknu taŋaŋ minet le nane ye idus ndayade.
Taŋgo nu ŋgaro pikit e ko nda pikit ta alo kugatok. Nu Tukul Guwa mbolŋge kitek mayok kinit ta ndo alo ŋak.
Nane wam ta son ŋga dubide mbal Kuate nu nane ŋgamuŋgal wamdus bul serniŋmba nu nuŋe mbal ŋakmba mbolŋge taŋawa. Son.
Ye Yesus tuku piro taŋgo minet. Yiŋe ŋgarosu mbolŋge katyinaig tuku nzilal wam ta kilimok te-mayokte. Ta tuku ande nu maŋ ye tuku nyu ŋayo sili ndawa.
Tira kame, siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nu tane ake sinaŋ make patikuwa. Son.
